decisions.reason: Electronic music boxes with church motifs are a seasonal Erzgebirge-style gift item that typically stays in the catalog for several Christmas seasons, although the electronic variant is less core to traditional woodcraft.
Wooden nativity stables are a core, evergreen product for a traditional German wood-products maker and are rarely discontinued shortly after launch.
Modern incense smoker figurines extend a staple product category to younger buyers, and such figurines are usually kept for multiple seasons to recover design and tooling costs.
